versions.changelog:
- Initial release of local-material-batch skill.
- Enables batch conversion of local video, audio, image, and text files into reusable text assets.
- Features a workflow using Inbox, dry-run, processing, and output manifest/summary.
- Supports pluggable backend strategies for text extraction (local, OCR, ASR).
- Ensures failures are tracked and reported in outputs.
- Designed for local-first, platform-agnostic material intake without platform scraping.
